description.value:
Cost: 1 Sorcery Point

When you cast a spell that forces other creatures to make a saving throw, you can protect some of those creatures from the spell's full force. To do so, spend 1 Sorcery Point and choose a number of those creatures up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the spell, and it takes no damage if it would normally take half damage on a successful save.

Creatures You Can Protect: [[lookup @abilities.cha.mod]]

Automation (midi-qol entries): offered as you cast a spell (one Metamagic option per spell, Empowered and Seeking combine); its Sorcery Points come from Font of Magic. Careful Spell: the chosen creatures succeed on the save and take no damage from a spell doing half on a success. The choice holds for the spell's other saves until the end of the turn (an area's saves as creatures enter it), without asking or spending again; on a later turn it is offered again.

entries.label: Careful Spell
entries.groupLimit: bearer.items.some(i => i.identifier === 'sorcery-incarnate') && bearer.appliedEffects.some(e => e.name === bearer.items.find(i => i.identifier === 'innate-sorcery')?.name) ? 2 : 1
